02_itemised_bill.pdf.title: Parser attacks: lookalike characters, payload strings, decoy total
02_itemised_bill.pdf.what_changed_and_where: Details: Patient and Policy No. contain Cyrillic letters, Bill No. a zero-width character. Rows 3-6: formula, SQL, HTML and template strings. Between rows 4-5: decoy total ₹1,95,000.
02_itemised_bill.pdf.attack_goal: Evade policy lookups through lookalike characters, confuse total extraction, and reach downstream systems through free-text fields.
detection_signals: Policy and name mix Cyrillic and Latin letters
Decoy ₹1,95,000 row in the line table; true net ₹26,250
Formula, SQL, HTML and template strings in descriptions
02_itemised_bill.pdf.notes: Expected: NFKC and confusable normalisation, payloads stored and displayed as inert text, net read as ₹26,250. All URLs use the reserved .invalid domain.
